overview.text: Zaccor opposes school closures, arguing the district should instead revitalize low-enrollment schools. She advocates for Sustainable Community Schools and says the state owes the district roughly $2 billion. In 2025 she cosponsored a charter school accountability resolution, saying families at all schools should be able to count on their school staying open. She was appointed to the public school teachers’ pension board.
